subject: executor: fix data race in parallel sort test (#52246)
summary: Reviewed the diff vs first parent in `pkg/executor/sortexec`. The change makes `parallelSortSpillHelper.spillImpl` always wait for its producer goroutine to finish by deferring `channel.Clear(spilledRowChannel)` (drains until the channel is closed), preventing early-return races. It also moves `close(e.Parallel.resultChannel)` to the end of `SortExec.generateResult`’s deferred cleanup so `SortExec.Close()` (which drains `resultChannel` before tearing down workers/spill state) cannot proceed until iter/disk cleanup is complete, removing a Close-vs-cleanup race. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, concurrency, or SQL-semantic issues found in this commit.
